facts.business: Lupin Limited is a global pharmaceutical company engaged in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of generic, branded generic, and specialty pharmaceutical products, including injectables and respiratory therapies, across India, the United States, other developed markets, emerging markets, and active pharmaceutical ingredients (API).

guidance_or_targets.statement: Progressing towards 100% sustainability assessment coverage of critical suppliers over a rolling three-year cycle
guidance_or_targets.metric: Sustainability assessment coverage of critical suppliers

key_risks: Rising global inflation and energy/food price pressures
Regulatory and compliance risks across geographies
Supply chain and sustainable sourcing risks
Environmental and waste management regulatory compliance
facts.related_party_note: During the year under review, all related party transactions entered were in the ordinary course of business and on an arm's length basis. The Company did not enter into any material significant related party transaction that had any potential conflict with the interests of the Company at large.
